title: Prefix-aware SLI inflation detector and regional circuit-sweep dashboard
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Instrument token-level latency with prefix metadata and expose a detection signal for SLI inflation caused by prefix cache misses, long-tail decoding backpressure, and regional admission anomalies. Build a Grafana dashboard that surfaces prefix-level latency distributions, region-by-region inflation deltas, and a simulated circuit-sweep panel used by on-call to proactively prune or re-route low-priority traffic. This ticket covers schema design, ingestion pipeline changes, dashboard panels, alert rules, and a small canary rollout in the eu-west and us-central regions.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry schema published: token_latency events include prefix_id, kv_cache_hit (true|false), admit_reason, route_id, region, shard_id, sample_rate
Pipeline ingest and storage support 10k events/s with 7 day retention for the sampled stream

Grafana dashboard with at least 6 panels: prefix distribution, kv_hit vs p99, regional inflation delta heatmap, simulated circuit-sweep preview, admit_reason breakdown, and synthetic traffic guardrail
Two alert rules: prefix-inflation > 2x baseline for 5m and regional inflation delta > 30% for 3m, each with runbook links
Canary deployment in eu-west and us-central with traffic shadowing and no customer-facing change
Runbook updated and ops sign-off from SRE and Runtime teams
tasks: Design telemetry proto and add fields to token_latency event
Add prefix extraction in request router (runtime) and tag events
Update ingestion consumer: enrich events with region/shard mapping and persist to observability bucket
Create Grafana panels and simulated circuit-sweep visualization
Author alerting rules and link to runbook
Canary rollout: shadow traffic, validate signals, and run sweep simulation
Post-mortem template and handoff to on-call
